name: Clinton Health Access Initiative
summary: Works with governments to lower the cost and improve the delivery of medicines, tests and health services.

programs.label: Community-based TB case finding, India
programs.weight_source: https://www.givewell.org/research/grants/clinton-health-access-initiative-tuberculosis-household-contact-management-june-2024 (grants dated 2022-01-01 to 2026-10-30): TB household contact management, India, Jun 2024, $15,092,329.

programs.label: Program performance management (organisational grant, not ranked)
programs.weight_source: https://www.givewell.org/research/grants/clinton-health-access-initiative-chai-program-performance-management-grant-october-2024 (grants dated 2022-01-01 to 2026-10-30): Oct 2024, $5,104,824 for CHAI's program performance management (PPM) team, an organisational grant, not TB care through private providers. Its BOTEC values improvements across the CHAI programs the team influences, not one program's outcomes, so it doesn't count: weight 0, and its money is not moved to another program.
